inlineSql: SELECT A.VCH_DATE AS WORK_DATE FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY A.VCH_DATE UNION SELECT B.VCH_DATE AS WORK_DATE FROM AC_DATA AS B WHERE B.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND B.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY B.VCH_DATE ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE

SELECT B.MAIN_BOOK As MAIN_BOOK,B.BOOK_SNAME AS BOOK_SNAME,A.VCH_DATE AS VCH_DATE,A.CO_BOOK AS CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO AS VCH_NO,A.AC_CODE AS AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME AS AC_NAME,A.IT_TYPE AS IT_TYPE,A.SIGN AS ITM_SIGN ,SUM(A.FINE_WT) As Fine,SUM(A.DR_AMT) As NetAmt FROM (AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE And A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.DR_AMT <> 0 AND A.FINE_WT <> 0 AND A.SIGN = '+' AND A.VCH_DATE = ' ? WORK_DATE ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY B.MAIN_BOOK,B.BOOK_SNAME,A.VCH_DATE,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME,A.IT_TYPE,A.SIGN UNION ALL SELECT E.MAIN_BOOK,E.BOOK_SNAME,D.VCH_DATE,D.CO_BOOK,D.VCH_NO,D.AC_CODE,F.AC_NAME,D.IT_TYPE,D.SIGN ,SUM(D.FINE_WT) As Fine,SUM(D.DR_AMT) As NetAmt FROM (AC_DATA AS D LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS E ON D.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE And D.LC_CODE = E.LC_CODE And D.CO_BOOK = E.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS F ON D.CO_CODE = F.CO_CODE AND D.AC_CODE = F.AC_CODE WHERE D.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND D.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND D.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND D.CR_AMT <> 0 AND D.FINE_WT <> 0 AND D.SIGN = '-' AND D.VCH_DATE = ' ? WORK_DATE ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY E.MAIN_BOOK,E.BOOK_SNAME,D.VCH_DATE,D.CO_BOOK,D.VCH_NO,D.AC_CODE,F.AC_NAME,D.IT_TYPE,D.SIGN ORDER BY B.MAIN_BOOK, A.CO_BOOK, A.VCH_NO

SELECT B.MAIN_BOOK,B.BOOK_SNAME,A.VCH_DATE,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME,SUM(ITM_PCS) As Pcs,SUM(A.ITM_GWT) As Gwt,SUM(A.ITM_GWT-A.ITM_NWT) As OthWt,SUM(A.ITM_NWT) As Nwt,SUM(A.ITM_FINE) As Fine, SUM(A.ITM_AMT) As ItAmt,SUM(A.LBR_AMT) AS LbrAmt,SUM(A.OTH_AMT) As OthAmt,SUM(A.NET_AMT) As NetAmt FROM (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE And A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.TR_TYPE = 'P' AND ITM_SIGN = '+' AND A.VCH_DATE = ' ? WORK_DATE ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT LOGIN_NAME FROM LOGIN_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = '01' GROUP BY LOGIN_NAME ORDER BY LOGIN_NAME
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.LC_CODE,A.AC_NAME

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 ORDER BY C.AC_NAME
SELECT BOOK_NAME ,CO_BOOK ,BOOK_TYPE,ITM_TYPE,MAIN_BOOK,BOOK_SNAME,BOOK_INOUT,MENU_NAME FROM BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? '
Select * From BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? '
SELECT A.BOOK_NAME As BookNameL,A.CO_BOOK As BookL FROM BOOK_DATA AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.BOOK_NAME
